notes: ANTI-SPAM toolkit: .block <number|reply> / .unblock / .blocklist / .spamlog — server-side block, spammer's messages never reach you again. .antispam on|off|<N> → DM flood guard (per-minute window → auto block + self-chat notice). Owner-only, no report-flood features (those get YOUR number banned). antispam.json survives .update.
